meta.frame: local metres east/north of meta.origin (houses.json frame); z above meta.z_base from block terrain (LiDAR mesh inside the square, USGS 3DEP DEM offset to it outside); edges densified to <= 2 m
meta.clip_note: polygons cut to the query box carry clipped: true - the cut edge is the box, not a lot line
meta.owner_rule: no owner / mailing / tax-name / sale fields requested; only geometry, parcel id, situs address
meta.hoa_rule: absence of data is 'no open HOA data', never 'non-HOA'; 'subdivision plat' = possible covenants, not a confirmed HOA
